items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee only mentions 'her sister' in response to the interviewer's mention of Loraine. There is no direct interaction or personal relationship described between the interviewee and Loraine.

ctx.x: Yeah, her sister was a great singer.

And Loraine used to play Austin the one he did with Dizzy in 1955, but both of them, Johnny Hartman was, you're right. You have to not feel anything if you listen to that and you can’t . . . really I play it all the time.
I know you remember that session but do you remember how it came about, who’s idea was it to marry those two?
